706009.name: Bountiful Gifts
706009.desc: Increases the healing of Shadra's Prayer, Green Salve, and Alkahest by 10%.

706012.name: Wilting Away
706012.desc: Your Wilt now strikes an additional nearby enemy.

706013.name: Improved Venoxis Fang
706013.desc: Reduces the cast time of Venoxis Fang by 0.5 sec and its cost by 30%.

706014.name: Widow's Watch
706014.desc: Allies affected by Shadra's Balm now have a 20% increased chance to resist poison and curse effects.

706015.name: Venom Glands
706015.desc: Increases your healing done by 15% on allies below 35% health or if they are Poisoned.

706016.name: Worship
706016.desc: Allows all critical heals to increase periodic healing the target receives from you by 10% for 5 seconds.

706018.name: Serpent Lord's Ritual
706018.desc: Direct healing done now has a 5% chance to grant you 5 sec of Serpent Lord's Amulet.

706020.name: Rotspreader
706020.desc: Serpent's Fang and Blight consume Venoxis Fang stacks, applying a stack of Rot for each.

706021.name: Mycelial Replenishment
706021.desc: Increases your critical strike chance and critical healing done by 20% for 20 seconds and instantly restore 30% of your maximum mana, but consumes all stacks of Mycelial Healing on all nearby allies. While active, all periodic critical strikes heal for an additional 20% of the healing done.

706023.name: Intoxicating Venoms
706023.desc: Level 40 Passive Mycosis is now enhanced based on your currently active Venom. Debilitating Venom: Reduces the cast time by -20%. Blight Venom: Extends the duration of Spore on the target by 4 sec. Adrenal Venom: Strikes 1 additional nearby target.

706025.name: Acid Bolt
706025.desc: Increases the damage of Venom Bolt by 10% and its critical strike chance by 2%.

706026.name: Bugging
706026.desc: Harmful spells cast out of Skulk increase the damage you deal to the enemy by 30% for 4 seconds.

706027.name: Venomancy Expert
706027.desc: Reduces the cost of all spells and abilities by -5%.

706028.name: Ritualistic Renewal
706028.desc: Your periodic healing done now increases the direct healing of your next Shadra's Prayer or Serpent's Fang by 2%, stacking 10 times.

706030.name: Infestation
706030.desc: Periodic damage dealt now has a 10% chance to reduce the cooldown of Serpent's Fang and Fungal Assailant by 20% of the remaining cooldown.

706033.name: Glory To Shadra!
706033.desc: Increases the critical strike chance of Venom Fang and Nerubian Sting by 10%.

706034.name: Nerubian Poison
706034.desc: Nerubian Sting now consumes Lethal Toxin to apply Nerubian Poison.

706036.name: Vile Fangs
706036.desc: Periodic damage dealt now has a 10% chance to generate a Brood Mark.

706038.name: Withered
706038.desc: Increases the spell power scaling of Withering Venom by 15%.

706039.name: Improved Facemelter
706039.desc: Reduces the cooldown of Facemelter by 30 sec.

706209.name: Rotpriest
706209.desc: Increases your spell critical damage by 100%.

706211.name: Spiritual Healing
706211.desc: Level 20 Passive Increases your spell critical strike rating and your healing power by 20% of your Intellect.

706212.name: Venom Cultist
706212.desc: Increases spell haste by 5% of Spirit.

706251.name: Escalation
706251.desc: Increases the damage of Wilt by 10% and healing of Gift of Shadra by 10%.

706271.name: Death Spray
706271.desc: Periodic damage dealt now has a 5% chance to remove the Energy cost from your next Venom Fang or Widow's Kiss within 8 seconds and increase its damage by 20%. Can occur only once every 2 sec.

706274.name: Dreamstride
706274.desc: Reduces the range at which enemy creatures can detect you. Movement speed increased by 40%. Fades upon dealing or taking damage.

706444.name: Graceful Exoskeleton
706444.desc: Dodging an attack now increases your chance to dodge by 1500% for 0.

706455.name: Fungic
706455.desc: You now apply Fungic to enemies affected by Lethargy, dealing an additional 20% of the damage dealt by your Venom Bolt or Serpent's Fang as Nature Damage over 3 seconds, stacking up to 2 times.

706477.name: Lifemender
706477.desc: Your Serpent's Fang now heals up to 5 additional nearby allies and Alkahest now heals an additional nearby target.

706714.name: Master of Rot
706714.desc: Increases the tick rate of Spore and Wilt by 20%.

706715.name: Cult Ichors
706715.desc: Increases the critical strike chance of Spore, Creeping Poison, and Blight Venom by 6%.

706716.name: Incineration - Level 15 Passive
706716.desc: Level 15 Passive Increases your spell haste by 15% of your Intellect and your spell damage by 20% of your Intellect.

706721.name: Cloud Chaser
706721.desc: Increases spell power by 21% of Intellect.

706766.name: Duke of Decay
706766.desc: Allows Serpent's Fang to also consume Cycle of Decay, making it free, instant and incur no cooldown.

706769.name: Shadra's Vigil Duration Setter Delayer
706769.desc: Causes Serpent's Fang to make your next Shadra's Vigil affect up to 3 allies.

706937.name: Shadra's Gift
706937.desc: Reduces the cast time of Shadra's Prayer by -10% and your spell pushback suffered from damaging attacks by 35%.

706938.name: Ophidian Renewal
706938.desc: Increases the duration of Shadra's Balm and Mending Mist and Shadra's Prayer by 3 sec.

706939.name: Mycelial Synchronization
706939.desc: Reduces the mana cost of healing spells by 10% and increases maximum mana by 5%.

706942.name: Protraction
706942.desc: Increases the duration of your Venomancer periodic damage effects by 3 sec.

706955.name: Enchanted Chitin
706955.desc: Increases your Armor contribution from mail by 25%.

706956.name: Prophetic Speaker
706956.desc: Each time you spawn a Mushroom, you now reduce the cooldown of Decay by -1 sec.

706958.name: Waste
706958.desc: Fang of Shadra consumes 2 stacks of Lethal Toxin from the target to deal 251 to 253 additional Nature damage, healing you equal to the damage dealt.

706959.name: Spindly
706959.desc: Causes Leg Strike to make your next Venom Fang strike up to 5 targets. Lasts 8 sec.

706962.name: Withering Venom
706962.desc: Inject an enemy with a devastating venom, dealing 17 + 20% nature SP Nature Damage every 3 sec for 21 seconds. Damage is dealt slowly at first, and builds up over time.

706966.name: Arachnified
706966.desc: Increases the damage of Fang of Shadra by 10%.

707224.name: Venoxis Rage
707224.desc: Your Mycosis now enrages your Fungarians for 6 seconds, increasing its damage and attack speed by 30% for 6 seconds.

707233.name: Suffocating Coils
707233.desc: Periodic damage now has a 5% chance to cause you to launch webs at your target, wrapping them in a Suffocating Coil.

707234.name: Suffocating Coil
707234.desc: Launch a beam of webbing at an enemy, inflicting 91 Nature damage every 1 sec for 4 sec. After 4 sec, if Spore is active on the target, drop a Mushroom below them that will explode after 2 sec, dealing 303 Nature damage to all enemies within 5 yds.

707236.name: Silver Trident
707236.desc: Damaging melee and ranged critical strikes have a chance to heal you equal to 40% of the damage dealt.

707320.name: Poisonous
707320.desc: Level 40 Passive Increases your spell damage by 30% of your attack power and allows periodic damage dealt by Expulsion to critically strike.

707382.name: Essence of Decay
707382.desc: Critical strikes with Widow's Kiss now apply 1 additional Brood Mark.

707404.name: Draconic - Level 15 Passive
707404.desc: Level 15 Passive Increases your critical strike rating by 10% of your Intellect, your spell damage by 30% of your Intellect, and your chance to hit by 3%.

707563.name: Playing With Poison
707563.desc: Increases your Nature Damage and healing done by 5%.

707570.name: Toxicity
707570.desc: Your Expulsion periodic damage can now critically strike.

707574.name: Venomcult Scrolls
707574.desc: Reduces the cooldown of Green Salve by -2 sec and increases the healing done at the end of the duration by 50%.

707668.name: Brood Lord
707668.desc: Augments Spider Form into a Brood Lord, causing your Brood Mark spenders to launch webs at the target, sticking to them for 10 seconds. Each webbed target has their movement speed slowed by -25%. Critically striking an enemy who is webbed summons 1 to 2 Spiderlings to aid you in combat for 8 seconds.

707689.name: Toxic Pheromones
707689.desc: Create a magic edict with an ally, increasing their spell power by 28.

707726.name: Soothing Venoms
707726.desc: Increases the critical healing of Shadra's Prayer by 25%.

712362.name: Blaster
712362.desc: Allows you to see and track stealthed targets on your minimap.

712455.name: Brood Web
712455.desc: Augments Spider Form into a Brood Lord, causing your Brood Mark spenders to launch webs at the target, sticking to them for 10 sec. Each webbed target has their movement speed slowed by 25%. Critically striking an enemy who is webbed summons a Spider Formling to aid you in combat against them for 10 sec.

712459.name: Greater Toxic Pheromones
712459.desc: Create a magic edict with an ally, increasing their spell power by 62.

800283.name: Serpent Lord
800283.desc: Transforms your Spider Form into a Serpent Form, increasing Nature Damage done by 10%, but giving some of your Spider Form abilities a 1 sec Cast Time and 10 yd increased Range. Dealing direct Nature Damage has a chance to cast a free Miasma on the target, Slowing them and creating a cloud of toxic venom that deals damage over time to enemies within. Affected abilities: Spider Form Bite, Fang of Shadra, Nerubian Poison, Widowmaker, Rotfang, Corroding Blight and Facemelter.

800666.name: Spellslinger
800666.desc: Switches your Runedaggers for two Rune Pistols, allowing you to use Mana Shot and Rift Shot.

800841.name: Spider Form
800841.desc: Shapeshift into Spider Form, increasing movement speed by 20%, making you immune to polymorph effects, and allowing the use of abilities that require this form.

800843.name: Skulk
800843.desc: Skulk through the shadows, entering stealth. Lasts until cancelled. While Skulking, your next Venom Fang or Widow's Kiss has no cost and deals 850% increased damage, scaling with your level.

800848.name: Skitter
800848.desc: Skitter forward a long distance. Can be used 3 times within 10 sec before triggering a cooldown. Usable while Skulking.

800869.name: Venom Bolt
800869.desc: Spew poison on an enemy, dealing 142.84 Nature damage and reducing healing received by 15% for 10 sec, stacking 2 times.

800870.name: Shadra's Prayer
800870.desc: Bring the glory of Shadra to an ally, healing them for 189.052, plus 29.524 every 3 sec for 21 sec.

800871.name: Facemelter
800871.desc: Requires Spider Form Consumes Brood Marks Spray poison upon an enemy and nearby enemies, dealing Nature Damage over 15 seconds. 1 Mark: 102 + 93.75% nature SP Nature Damage. 2 Marks: 130 + 120% nature SP Nature Damage. 3 Marks: 167 + 153.75% nature SP Nature Damage. 4 Marks: 212 + 195% nature SP Nature Damage. 5 Marks: 285 + 262.5% nature SP Nature Damage.

800876.name: Web Wrap
800876.desc: Channels a beam of webbing at an enemy, slowing their movement speed by 60% and inflicting 183.2 Nature damage every 1 sec for 4 sec. While active, the target takes 30% increased damage from your other periodic damage effects. Can be used in any form.

800878.name: Ambush Predator
800878.desc: Casting Burrow will now apply Tunnel Below to you. While Skulk is active every 1 sec you reduce the cooldown of Burrow by -1 sec.

800879.name: Spider Form Jump
800879.desc: Leap upon an enemy, generating 1 Rage and rooting them in place for 0. Increases damage dealt by 12% for 10 sec.

800880.name: Venom Fang
800880.desc: Applies 1 Brood Mark Bite an enemy for 120 Nature damage.

800882.name: Nerubian Sting
800882.desc: Applies 1 Brood Mark Sting an enemy, dealing 28 + 25% shadow SP Shadow Damage and an additional 25 + 50% shadow SP over 15 seconds, stacking up to 3 times.

800883.name: Leg Strike
800883.desc: Requires Scorpid or Stalker Form 3 Charges 12 sec recharge Strike up to 4 enemies for 142 Stormstrike Damage and generate 15 rage.

800885.name: Widow's Kiss
800885.desc: Requires Stalker Form Bite an enemy for 222 Shadow Damage, increasing your melee haste by 20% for 4 sec. If the target is affected by Lethal Toxin, consume it to afflict them with Leech Poison, leeching health over time.

800887.name: Spindlebind
800887.desc: Emit webs at all enemies in a 10 yd cone behind you, rooting them for 4 seconds, and unleashing a beetle on the trapped enemy from below, inflicting 67 + 40% nature SP Nature Damage.

800888.name: Fang of Shadra
800888.desc: Requires Stalker Form Bite an enemy for 273 Plague Damage, refreshing 1 Leg Strike charge. This spell always critically strikes and generates 10 rage. If the target is affected by 2 stacks of Lethal Toxin, consume them to deal additional 579 Nature Damage. If the target is affected by Leech Poison, afflict them with Dread Poison for 8 sec.

800891.name: Drenched Fangs
800891.desc: Gives your Auto Attacks a chance to apply your Fang Venom effects.

800892.name: Harden
800892.desc: Harden your carapace, reducing damage taken by 45%, decaying quickly over 10 sec and healing for 1% maximum health each time a stack is removed. Taking Physical Damage during this time will cause it to decay faster. Leaving Beetle Form will cancel this effect.

800894.name: Fury of Anub'Rekhan
800894.desc: Increases your maximum mana, Energy, and Rage by 10%.

800895.name: Catalyst
800895.desc: Generates 15 Rage plus 5 every 1 sec and reduces the cost of all of your spells and abilities by -25% for 10 seconds. Prevents out of combat Rage decay for its duration.

800897.name: Vizier's Gift
800897.desc: Heal an ally and yourself for 144.88 and refresh the duration of Shadra's Vigil by 30 sec and applies your Fang Venom effects. Can only be used on allies affected by Shadra's Vigil.

800899.name: Mending Mist
800899.desc: Spread a precarious mist to up to 8 allies within 30 yds, healing them for 10 + 15% healing every 1 sec for 7 seconds. After 1.69 sec, all allies within 30 yds are healed for an additional 104 + 33% healing.

800900.name: Ritual Healing
800900.desc: Channel your life force into an ally for 5 sec, increasing the effectiveness of active periodic healing spells by 20%. Every 1 sec, you consume 2 sec of Shadra's Vigil from the target to heal them for 57 and restore 0% maximum mana.

800901.name: Shadra's Balm
800901.desc: Envelop an ally with a restorative balm, healing them for 28 + 22% healing every 3 sec for 18 seconds.

800902.name: Green Salve
800902.desc: Rapidly heal an ally for 30 over 6 seconds. At the end of the duration, this will seek another nearby ally with the lowest health and heal them for 13 + 24.46% healing.

800904.name: Unity
800904.desc: Heals up to 8 allies within 12 yds of the targeted location for 519 and applies Shadra's Vigil to them.@ext::ext@

800905.name: Antivenom
800905.desc: Cure 1 poison effect on the target, repeating every 4 seconds for 12 sec.

800910.name: Decay
800910.desc: Apply Wilt to up to 5 enemies at target location and drop a Mushroom that will explode after 2 sec, dealing 74 + 25% nature SP Nature Damage all enemies within 5 yds.

800914.name: Serpent Lord's Amulet
800914.desc: Draw power from the Serpent Lord's Amulet, increasing your spell haste by 20% and reduces your mana costs by -50% for 15 seconds.

800920.name: Shadra's Binding
800920.desc: Stuns an enemy for 2 sec. Can be used in Spider Form.

800921.name: Parasite
800921.desc: Requires Skulking Embed yourself into an enemy or ally player for 1 min, becoming immune to all damage, but unable to attack or cast spells. At the end of the duration, or upon casting Parasite: Unburrow, you reappear at their location. If they are an enemy, you inflict them with Parasite Poison. Not usable in combat. This ability goes on cooldown upon exiting your target.

800946.name: Serpent's Fang
800946.desc: Launch vile poison at an enemy, dealing 243 Nature damage and healing up to 5 allies near them for 361.68.

801013.name: Lethargic
801013.desc: Increases resource costs by 100%, stacking 1 times, for 5 sec.

801048.name: Travel Form Slow and Root dispel effect

801091.name: Rime
801091.desc: Deals Frost Damage to all nearby enemies and Slows their Movement Speed by 20% for 3.5 sec. Generates 1 Essence of Frost.

802326.name: Fortify Carapace
802326.desc: Gain an additional stack of Carapace Regeneration, up to 5.

802840.name: Lethal Toxin
802840.desc: Reduces Shadow and Nature Resistance by 4% for 15 sec, stacking 5 times.

803177.name: Spider Pheromones
803177.desc: Inject an ally with spider pheromones, increasing their Agility by 6. Lasts 30 min.

803183.name: Beetle Form
803183.desc: Shapeshift into Beetle Form, allowing the use of abilities that require this form and increasing your armor contribution by 100% and your maximum health by 500% of your Intellect and Agility. While active, you are immune to polymorph effects, your damage taken is reduced by 10%, and your threat generated is increased by 120%, plus an additional 50% from Nature damage dealt.

803184.name: Beetle or Spider Form
803184.desc: Enables the use of abilities that can be used in Spider Form or Beetle Form.

803193.name: Hivebreak
803193.desc: Pierce an enemy with your front leg, dealing 32 Nature damage. Consumes 2 sec of Venomtip Poison's duration to cause 140 Nature damage to nearby enemies.

803194.name: Corrosion
803194.desc: Unleash toxic corrosion, increasing the target's Nature Damage taken by 5% for 15 sec.

803195.name: Venomtip Poison
803195.desc: Spray poison on an enemy and all enemies within 8 yds of your target, dealing 33 + 11% nature SP + 10% AP Nature Damage and reducing their attack speed by -20% for 10 seconds.

803197.name: Regrow Exoskeleton
803197.desc: Clears Exposed Flesh stacks to reduce your damage taken by -20% for 5 seconds and an additional 1 sec per stack.

803198.name: Claw Strike
803198.desc: Smash an enemy and up to 3 enemies with your claw, dealing 25 Nature damage, scaling with your Stamina. Generates 20 Rage.

803199.name: Carapace Crash
803199.desc: Slam your body against the ground dealing 90 Nature damage to enemies within 8 yds.

803201.name: Toxic Sludge
803201.desc: Place a toxic pool on the ground for 6 sec, instantly Burning enemies inside for 93 Nature Damage. Enemies in the pool take 58.64 Nature Damage every 3 sec, and have 50% reduced movement speed. Allies in the pool are healed for 52 to 53 every 2 sec and take 5% increased healing.

803203.name: Toxflinger
803203.desc: Launches bolts of poison at all enemies within 20yd that are standing in the pool created by Toxic Sludge, dealing 92 to 94 Nature Damage to affected enemies.

803212.name: Sea Serpent Form
803212.desc: Shapeshift into Sea Serpent form, increasing swim speed by 75% and allowing the Venomancer to breathe underwater.

803213.name: Regeneration
803213.desc: Applies Regeneration to you and all allies within 0 yards that are affected by Shadra's Vigil, Healing them for 1 every second for 5 sec. At the end of the duration, each affected ally will regain 1% of their Maximum Mana. Can be cast while moving.

803525.name: Brood Trap
803525.desc: Lay a clutch of eggs in front of you for 5 min, enemies who walk over the eggs take 871 Nature damage and are rooted for 30 sec (6 sec vs players), and then attacked by Spiderlings. Damage caused may interrupt the effect. You can have a maximum of 6 Brood Traps active at once. Usable while Skulking. Cannot be used in combat.

803537.name: Parasite: Unburrow
803537.desc: Unburrow from your target and appear near them, instantly applying Parasite Poison if they are an enemy.

803570.name: Chitin Rush
803570.desc: Rush forward and strike enemies in your path, dealing 37 Nature damage. Damage dealt generates increased threat.

803651.name: Beetle Pheromones
803651.desc: Increase the friendly target's armor by 105 and all primary stats by 4 for 30 min. Does not stack with other similar effects.

803657.name: Greater Beetle Pheromones
803657.desc: Increase all nearby party and raid member's armor by 285 and all primary stats by 12 for 30 min. Does not stack with other similar effects.

803982.name: Toxic Renewal
803982.desc: Instantly heals an ally for 105.6 to 111.6. For the next 30 sec, that ally cannot be targeted by this spell again.

804342.name: Prowler
804342.desc: Level 20 Passive Increases your spell damage by 25% of your Intellect and your hit rating by 3% of your Intellect.

804549.name: Miasma
804549.desc: Create an 8 yd cloud of poison at a location for 18 sec, causing 146.4 Nature Damage to 0 enemies within it every 2 sec. Every 2 sec, all enemies in the cloud are afflicted with Lethargy, reducing their movement speed by 3% for 8 sec, stacks up to 1 times.

804687.name: Venom Shield
804687.desc: Reduces the duration of all poison effects used on you by 10%, and reduces all periodic Magic damage taken by 5%. Lasts 30 min.

804961.name: Widowmaker
804961.desc: Requires Spider Form Consumes Brood Marks Inject shadow venom into an enemy, dealing Shadow damage and reducing their healing received by 50% for 8 seconds. 1 Mark: 44 + 56.25% shadow SP Shadow Damage. 2 Marks: 56 + 72% shadow SP Shadow Damage. 3 Marks: 72 + 92.25% shadow SP Shadow Damage. 4 Marks: 91 + 117% shadow SP Shadow Damage. 5 Marks: 123 + 157.5% shadow SP Shadow Damage.

804962.name: Celerity
804962.desc: Increases your movement speed by 60% for 10 seconds. Leaving Spider Form will cancel this effect. Usable while Skulking.

804963.name: Lifeblood
804963.desc: Embrace Shadra's lifeblood, reducing your damage taken and pushback from casting spells by -20% and causing all damage taken to cast Rejuvenating Venom. Lasts for 10 seconds.

804964.name: Noxious Empowerment
804964.desc: Enrage for 12 seconds, increasing your chance to trigger Venoms by 50%, your Energy regeneration by 100%, and increasing your damage dealt by 20% for 12 seconds.

804965.name: Skittering Rush
804965.desc: Enrages you for 8 sec whenever Tunnel Below ends, increasing movement speed by 40% and damage dealt by 10% and reduces the cooldown of Spider Form Jump by 90%. Your next Gripping Webs consumes the effect to trigger with a 90% reduced cooldown.

804967.name: Venocannon
804967.desc: Burst out of your burrow, rooting yourself in place for 0.001 sec. While active, all spells have 15 yd of additional range, and the cast times are reduced by 40%. Can only be used while Skulking.

804968.name: Hive Instinct
804968.desc: The swarm stirs within you, preparing you for battle, instantly generating 100 Rage and Energy. Usable while Skulking.

804969.name: Virulent Resonance
804969.desc: Increases the effectiveness of Brood Marks by 10% and your hit chance by 5%.

804970.name: Arachnophobia
804970.desc: Emerge from the shadows and horrify all nearby enemies for 3.5 sec.

804973.name: Vileburst
804973.desc: Increases the damage of Withering Venom by 25% on enemies above 75% health.

804974.name: Widowmaker (Bursting Sore)
804974.desc: Damage dealt now applies Bursting Sores for -0.001 sec, stacking 5 times. Can only occur once per 0.2 sec. At 10 stacks the sores explode dealing 155 Nature Damage to 10 nearby enemies and applying Lethal Toxin.

804975.name: Boding Dread
804975.desc: Increases your Shadow Damage dealt and your critical strike chance with Shadow spells by 3%.

804976.name: Lair Guard
804976.desc: Spider Form Jump now generates an additional 10 Rage and Shadra's Lair now reduces all damage taken by 10% and their cooldowns are reduced by 15 sec.

804977.name: Rotfang
804977.desc: Requires Spider Form Consumes Brood Marks Inject venom into an enemy that rots them from the inside out, dealing Plague Damage over 24 seconds. 1 Mark: 272 + 220% SP Plague Damage. 2 Marks: 348 + 281.6% SP Plague Damage. 3 Marks: 446 + 360.8% SP Plague Damage. 4 Marks: 566 + 457.6% SP Plague Damage. 5 Marks: 762 + 616% SP Plague Damage. Damage dealt pierces absorption effects and resistances.

804982.name: Wilt
804982.desc: Wilt the life of an enemy with vile poison, dealing 96 Nature Damage over 18 seconds.

804983.name: Spore
804983.desc: Inject an enemy with parasitic spores, dealing 24 + 25% nature SP Shadow Damage, plus an additional 147 over 21 seconds. After 10 sec, drop a Mushroom below the target that explodes after 2 sec, dealing 74 + 25% nature SP Nature Damage to nearby enemies.

804984.name: Venom Saturation
804984.desc: Increases the damage of your poison effects by 25% against enemies above 50% health.

804986.name: Mycosis
804986.desc: Fungus grows throughout the body of an enemy, dealing 144 + 65% nature SP Nature Damage and applying a shield that absorbs the next 100 + 200% SP healing done to them for 8 seconds. Deals 15% increased damage for each stack of Fungal Growth on the target.

804989.name: Sporelord
804989.desc: Fungal Assailant now spawns a Big Mushroom below the target.

805093.name: Cunning
805093.desc: Increases the critical strike chance of Chitin Rush by 20% and its critical damage by 10%.

805094.name: Expulsion
805094.desc: Clears Exposed Flesh stacks to poison nearby enemies for 5 seconds, and an additional 1 sec per cleared stack, dealing 15 + 10% nature SP + 5% AP Nature Damage every 1 sec.

805096.name: Nullifying Toxin
805096.desc: Inject an enemy with nullifying toxin, interrupting them and preventing any spell from that school from being cast for 3 sec.

805098.name: Venomancer (Fortitude)
805098.desc: Hostile attacks against you have 50% chance to apply a stack of Exposed Flesh, increasing Physical Damage taken by 3%, stacks up to 10 times, and generating 10 Rage.

805102.name: Molt
805102.desc: Shatters your exoskeleton, instantly applying 15 stacks of Exposed Flesh and increasing your movement speed by 30% for 8 seconds.

805124.name: Glitch
805124.desc: Apply a Glitch to an enemy target for 5 sec, causing them to periodically teleport to a random nearby location every 0 sec. While active, the target

805140.name: Cunning of the Nerub'ar
805140.desc: Augments your Spider Form, increasing your damage dealt by 10% and causing it to allow your Nerubian Sting to stack 1 additional time.

805141.name: Wasp Form
805141.desc: Shapeshift into Wasp Form, increasing movement speed by 150% and allowing you to fly. Can only shapeshift into Wasp Form in Outland or Northrend, and cannot be used in Combat.

805341.name: Organocannon
805341.desc: Burst out of your burrow, rooting yourself in place for -0.001 sec but causing your Venom Spit ability to deal 20% increased damage and have no cooldown for the duration. Can only be used while Tunneling.

805405.name: Venoxis Fang
805405.desc: Blast an enemy with a jet of toxic venom, dealing 303.8 Shadow Damage, increasing the damage the target takes from this spell by 5% and its mana cost by 5% for 6 sec, stacks 5 times. If your target is afflicted with Lethargy, this spell incurs no cooldown. Usable while moving. Scales with modifiers to Venom Bolt.

805568.name: Spawn
805568.desc: Bring a dead ally back to life with 400 health and 635 mana. Can be used in combat. Not usable in arena.

805569.name: Webbing
805569.desc: Brings a dead player back to life, wrapped in Webbing, with 1 health and 0 mana. The target remains in the Webbing for 5 sec. While in the Webbing, the target takes 50% increased damage, but being Healed reduces the remaining duration of the effect. This spell can be used in Combat.

805731.name: Debilitating Venom
805731.desc: Activate Debilitating Venom for 2 hour, giving your casts a 30% chance to inject a target and enemies around them with a crippling venom that slows their movement speed by 40% for 8 sec. You can have a maximum of 2 unique Venoms active at a time.

805732.name: Creeping Poison
805732.desc: Inflicts Nature damage to an enemy every 2 sec. for 14 sec.

805775.name: Adrenal Venom
805775.desc: Activate Adrenal Venom for 120 minutes, giving your casts a 25% chance to increase your haste by 6% for 6 seconds, stacking 3 times. You can have a maximum of 2 unique Venoms active at a time.

805776.name: Blight Venom
805776.desc: Activate Blight Venom for 2 hour, giving your harmful spells and abilities a 30% chance to poison an enemy dealing 822000 Shadow Damage over 6 sec. You can have a maximum of 2 unique Venoms active at a time.

805777.name: Nullifying Venom
805777.desc: Activate Nullifying Venom for 2 hour, giving your casts a 30% chance to reduce an enemy's casting speed by 30% for 8 sec. You can have a maximum of 2 unique Venoms active at a time.

805884.name: Extraction
805884.desc: For 15 seconds, your Intellect and Spirit are doubled and all critical periodic healing done by you restores 5% of your missing mana.

805900.name: Envenom
805900.desc: Reduces the cast time of Venom Bolt by -0.3 sec.

805931.name: Carapace Regeneration
805931.desc: 3 Charges, 20 sec recharge Regenerate your carapace, reducing your Physical Damage taken by -4% and restoring 1% maximum health every 1 sec, draining 10 Rage every tick to remain active, stacking 3 times.

806449.name: Mycelial Healing
806449.desc: All effective healing done now increases your periodic healing done to an ally by 1% for 30 seconds, stacking 10 times.

806602.name: Acidfang
806602.desc: The next Rotfang, Withering Venom, or Facemelter within 15 sec has 1% reduced duration and ticks 2% faster, stacking 10 times.

806604.name: Acid Burns
806604.desc: Scoring a Nature Critical Strike grants you a stack of Acidfang, increasing the Quickness of your next Facemelter by 1%.

806940.name: Rabies
806940.desc: Decays the life of an enemy target with vile poison, causing 72 Nature Damage every 2 sec for 30 sec.

807154.name: Fungarian Passive
807154.desc: Enraged. Damage dealt increased by 0% and attack speed increased by 40%.

807243.name: Corrosive Toxin
807243.desc: Withering Venom now deals an additional 125% shadow SP Shadow Damage at the end of its duration.

807601.name: Rotting Sores
807601.desc: Increases the tick rate of Rotfang by -20% and allows its periodic damage dealt to critically strike.

807608.name: Bursting Sore
807608.desc: Damage dealt now applies Bursting Sores for -0.001 sec, stacking 5 times. Can only occur once per 0.2 sec. At 10 stacks the sores explode dealing 155 Nature Damage to 0 nearby enemies and applying Lethal Toxin.

807610.name: Caustic
807610.desc: Reduces the cooldown of Noxious Empowerment by -60 sec.

807758.name: Parasite Poison
807758.desc: Movement speed slowed by 50%. Unable to critically strike. Lasts 10 sec.

807759.name: Lure
807759.desc: Lure an enemy, attracting their attention for 3 sec and forcing players to move. Does not break stealth.

850011.name: Vizier - Level 40 Passive
850011.desc: Level 40 Passive Venomcult Blessing now reduces the damage taken of affected allies by 5%.

887017.desc: Tuning aura for Venomancer Class. Modifies damage dealt, damage taken, and healing done.
